name: Das
desc: Das is a Vesperian NPC. Interacting with them sends you to the [Temple Sparring Hall](location:temple_sparring_hall_dungeon) and initiates Training Mode. They are the Etrean Luminant counterpart of [Regarde](entity:regarde), the instructor at [Greathive Aratel](location:greathive_aratel).
additional_info: -   Das wears the Vigil Initiate outfit.
